name: rib_in_the_corner_of_the_l
why: ENTRY W1.2. The corner rib of an L bracket: the recipe of the probe of 28/9/2026 (Checks/Rib/Program.cs, line L1), redone with the operations of the catalogue. The API guide (IFeatureManager~InsertRib.html and the only example, Get_Rib_Feature_Data_Example_CSharp.htm) calls InsertRib with IsNormToSketch = false, parallel to the sketch: the rib grows IN the plane of the line up to the walls. The historical probes passed true and nothing was born. Here the right direction of the material is the STRAIGHT one: the operation tries it first and must succeed at the first attempt.
_the_numbers: L 60x60 thick 10, deep 50: (60 x 10 + 50 x 10) x 50 = 55000. Plane at half depth (z = 25). The line from (10,40) to (40,10) touches the two inner walls (x = 10 and y = 10) and lies in the void: the rib fills the triangle (10,10)-(10,40)-(40,10), 30 x 30 / 2 = 450 mm2, thick 6: +2700. The probe measured 55000 -> 57700, and with the material flipped no rib.
defect_caught: A rib normal to the sketch (IsNormToSketch = true, the probes of 16/9) is not born: the answer would be a refusal and the case red. A rib born inside the material would leave the volume at 55000: the expectation on the volume sees it. The offset plane made by the operation is counted in «state.planes_available».

expect.why: THE L SITS WHERE THE LINE EXPECTS IT: corner at the origin and depth along +Z (the front plane is XY, normal +Z). If this is red, the rib of the next step is not to blame.

expect.tolerance_why: the volume is read from GetMassProperties in cubic metres; the probe measured +2700 to the tenth
the same number read from the state instead of from the answer

expect.why: in the L the probe saw it born with the straight material and not with the flipped one
the three base planes plus the one at z = 25 that the operation made for the sketch
IRibFeatureData2.ExtrusionDirection = swRibParallelToSketch: what the feature DECLARES, next to the volume which is the measurement
the rib sits inside the L: the bounding box does not change
the rib merges with the L, it does not make a separate body
the extrusion and the rib; the plane and the sketch are not features of the state
